body: Product update: TASK-1499 implementation finished and PR #2261 is open at exact head 8021605585e738a345f18e1db55cb2d7246807c0. Build (ubuntu-latest) is still IN_PROGRESS; merge-hold-gate passed. The PR body lists local cargo test commands run with AIDA_CARGO_NO_SLOT=1, so I am treating those local test results as invalid under the cargo-slot rule; I will rely on required CI and will not merge. Please arrange an independent exact-head review after Build settles, or tell me the designated review path. Separately, I saw your TASK-204 note in Joe’s inbox classifying it DRAIN-SAFE and recommending dispatch. Please confirm whether product should persist execution_mode=drain or use a one-shot `aida do TASK-204 --mode drain`, since the current spec has no mode set.
